meta.title: OSE CEB Press v17.08 with soil shaker
meta.label: 6 × 12 × 4
notes: Geometry: OSE CEB_17.08_CAD_Assembly.fcstd. Cylinders split at the rod shoulder; a plain rod continues each rod inside its barrel.
Drawer stations and ram strokes derived from the drawer walls, chamber liners and table plates; loose fill 7.0 in to a 4 in block is indicative.
Shaker (OSE a-z Build 1.0) placed indicatively on the back right hopper support; the spinning hammer is an eccentric that shakes the hopper through the support.

phases: Ram drops to load: soil falls from the hopper through the drawer (shaker on)
Drawer slides over: its closed block covers the chamber
Main cylinder compresses the block to 4 in
Drawer moves on: its open end over the chamber
Main cylinder raises the brick flush with the table
Drawer returns to fill: its block pushes the brick out onto the table
Lift the brick off and stack it
